summary: Salazar sponsored H.Res. 1117 in April 2024 opposing "one-sided pressure on Israel" and criticized the Biden administration's ceasefire push and U.S. abstention at the UN. In 2021 she co-signed a letter to the FBI and FinCEN demanding an investigation into PACBI's financial ties to Hamas and PIJ, framing BDS as terrorism. She also voted Yea in May 2024 on the Antisemitism Awareness Act, which directs use of the IHRA definition in education-discrimination enforcement.
